verdict.rationale: Pigment's finance page says it is integrated "through native connectors, open APIs, and scheduled imports", which hints at programmatic access. Nothing shows that those APIs export model outputs such as metrics, forecasts or scenario results to a warehouse or internal tool, and the OpenAPI spec probes all returned 404. The MCP server and the Audit Trail API cover different needs (AI assistant access and security events) and are not credited here. Missing for 10: a documented data-export API or warehouse connector for model outputs, published API reference or spec, explicit export of scenario and forecast results, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull model outputs (metrics, forecasts, scenario results) into a warehouse or internal tool through a documented export or API

citations.quote: easily integrated through native connectors, open APIs, and scheduled imports.
